processing.normal: Built-in phase generation and one bounded phase03 right-leg correction, followed by fixed 1024/1254 isotropic normalization. Only detached alpha<=2 exterior marks removed. No Python part editing or per-frame fitting. Contact normals02/04/06 are exact-byte canonical reuse.
processing.pixel: Built-in generation supplied only the accepted same-phase normal. Fixed128/1254 nearest sampling, alpha>=128 binarization and nearest mapping to the shared30-color palette. Uniform whole-frame alignment only:01Y-2,02Y0,03Y-1,05Y-3; phase02 uses no translation; each checked for zero clipping and exact inverseRGBA equality.
processing.contactReuse: New contact pixel02 is copied byte-for-byte into04/06. Historical canonical pixel candidates were not selected because their face/fur style differed in the mixed sequence.
processing.boundedRepairs: Phase03 normal recovery amplitude and phase03 pixel framing each received one bounded generated correction; earlier versions are preserved.

Three legs and single hooves, one central eye, two inward-curving tusks, body proportions and hidden-tail occlusion remain readable through image-left, image-right and central recovery/contact return.

Phase03 used a new80px target, first lifted113px with excessive knee/hoof rotation, and the accepted bounded correction lifts68px. The short central phase05 target was24px and its actual lift is38px.
Normal supporting hoof bottoms vary by up to1px. Pixel support and phase registration residuals are at most1px in the final selected pairs.

Relative to same-normal128 diagnostics: phase01 pixel width+2/height+1 and crown-2px; phase03 width+2/height+1 and crown-2px; new contact02 width+2/height-1 and crown+1px; phase05 width+2/height+2 and crown-2px. Phase03 tusk curves are more angular, and eye dark areas/reflections and fur grain differ between generated frames. Replacing the historical contact pixel reduced the alternating pupil/reflection style.
Exact leg-root depth, strict load transfer, forward displacement, body lean and hidden tail delay are not established by these front-view stills. No hidden anatomy was added.
